name: rene-roscher-skills
description: Engineering skills for coding agents: evidence before claims, multi-tenant SaaS, Laravel, Go, web, delivery, infrastructure and product work.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Goal focus, work on smaller models, a glossary of EU and German ecosystem terms, subagent delegation, evidence before claims, verification, safe actions, project inception, scaffolding from official starters, planning, delivery, tests, maintainable code, lessons, tooling, commits, stack bootstrap, performance. Stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: saas
plugins.description: Multi-tenant B2B SaaS: tenancy model, domain design and events, localization, external IDs, isolation, RBAC, plan entitlements, build vs buy, EU B2B billing, GDPR, EU and German legal baseline, service boundaries, async jobs, egress and webhooks.

plugins.name: laravel
plugins.description: Laravel architecture and production runtime decisions for long-lived workers, PostgreSQL and Valkey.

plugins.name: web
plugins.description: Public pages as their own deployment, client-rendered dashboards, Vue and Inertia, premium design quality and headless browser verification.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: Local Docker Compose stacks, GitHub Actions hardening, container image baselines and signed, verifiable releases.

plugins.name: docs-tools
plugins.description: Optional plugin that installs the Context7 documentation MCP server.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Optional hooks that enforce two core rules a prompt cannot guarantee: stop after ten failed fix attempts and ask, and never skip or silence a check (--no-verify, HUSKY=0, check || true).

plugins.name: business
plugins.description: Product discovery, dated market analysis, pricing and unit economics for B2B SaaS, and copy that reads as written by a person.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: Search and AI discoverability that holds up, live measurement through Search Console, Bing and Plausible with a measure, change and re-measure loop, and a B2B go-to-market from launch to sales motion.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: PostgreSQL in production: queries, indexes, migrations without downtime, pooling and the traps that only show on PostgreSQL.

plugins.name: infra
plugins.description: Infrastructure as code, Kubernetes workloads, edge proxy and TLS, observability and DR, and failover for DNS, mail, hosting, PostgreSQL and object storage.

plugins.name: api
plugins.description: Public REST API contracts and MCP servers that agents can use safely.

plugins.name: go
plugins.description: Production Go services and the contracts between services in different languages.

plugins.name: media
plugins.description: Short product and explainer videos: plan and approve before rendering, then build, voice, sound, master and deliver with measured checks.
